justification: Right, quick one before the kettle's even on the boil: Cook, JSN and Golden stay put 'cause I fancy them and they're earning it, Gesicki's in 'cause he's got the bounce, and JAX's D is locked in early doing its thing against Baltimore so that's that sorted. The two calls that matter - Questionable tag or not, Christian McCaffrey is gorgeous when healthy and I'm not benching that for Ollie Gordon over a number, so Gordon's riding pine and CMC's in, goose egg risk and all. And Malik Nabers is going straight into the flex over Tucker - I don't need a spreadsheet to tell me Nabers has more bite than a fella getting 34 snaps and one target last week, simple as. Aubrey's automatic at kicker. Kim can keep sending me trade pitches for the lad I'm about to start against her own defense - that's not a deal, hun, that's a tell.
